query: Plan a new completion payload version carrying product-name snapshots, while preserving strict older schemas and rolling out all subscribing services.
Inventory's completion consumer needs durable duplicate protection across restart. Trace its semantic operation ID and atomic effect/receipt transaction before changing it.
Fix the order relay so it marks outbox publication only after RabbitMQ confirmation, retaining stable event and operation IDs on retry.
Plan how Finance handles a parseable legacy v1 completion that lacks sale details. We need explicit failure rather than fetching Orders.
can we add an optional field to OrderCompleted v2 without breaking older consumers? read the strict contract and plan compatibility first.
Change the Customers completion effect to keep currency-separated spend totals exact across redelivery and owner retry.
Define what happens if a failed completion is retried with the same operationId but different quantities; don't assume ON CONFLICT compares payloads.
Plan adding a new subscriber's durable local receipt and completion effect without coordinating it from Orders.
Change malformed order-message handling so invalid payloads are durably retained before acknowledgement. Include recovery and duplicate tests.
Review a change that moves the stock write outside the effect receipt transaction, and explain the crash/retry consequences.
Rename an internal TypeScript variable called eventId in a standalone helper without changing any wire payload or retry behavior.
Explain the existing event envelope fields for a glossary entry. Do not evolve contracts, publication or consumer effects.
Add a browser click event for a static navigation control. This task has no RabbitMQ, order fact or completion effect changes.
Compare choreography and orchestration as concepts in a training paragraph, without reviewing or changing this repository.
Expose the existing Inventory history GET route through the staff gateway. No order fact, outbox or consumer behavior is changing.
Fix a typo in an event type's Markdown heading only; leave schema identifiers and all code unchanged.
Explain RabbitMQ publisher confirmation terminology, without tracing or changing the boba outbox or acknowledgement implementation.
Format an existing integration test import list. Do not change test assertions, event fixtures or consumer behavior.
Suggest a label for the staff dashboard's event-status heading. Preserve processing truth and all response/event semantics.
Add strict pagination validation to an internal Inventory history read endpoint. It neither publishes order facts nor applies downstream effects.
